the three-dimensional effective theory is the natural starting point for studying the phase transition in SU(3) gauge theory, and that the three-dimensional gauge theory is the natural candidate for the effective theory of the deconfined phase of QCD.

a local three-dimensional action is sufficient for describing the large distance physics in SU (3), and that this is not the case for SU (2).
